verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt, with agent-directed instructions in its content, and a markdown rendition of the Issuing docs at issuing.md. The many .md doc URLs show agents can fetch clean markdown pages, and the official MCP server lets agents search Stripe's knowledge base. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the Issuing docs, and evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes the Issuing section.
